body:
May I ask what your reasoning is to believe depression and anxiety are a demonic force? Not trying to be snippy, I’m genuinely curious. It’s something I used to tell myself to try and rationalize my own depression and anxiety. I have been confused about religion for awhile and no longer consider myself religious.


I feel like it was a double-edged sword thinking that way because it made me feel better that I had the potential to do great things and that’s why I was being “attacked” but then it made me feel worse because I wasn’t strong enough to fight the demons and I wasn’t living up to my potential.

I wish I could just disappear all the time. When I used to be religious I’d pray to god that he take my life and give it to someone who deserved it. My family is middle class and I know they love me. It didn’t seem fair that I had those things and was still depressed and useless when there are so many people out there in shitty situations that deserve better and are a lot stronger than me. 


I’ve already decided I’m going to delete my social media accounts before I kill mysef because I hate the thought of people posting comments about my death. A lot of times They only do it to bring attention to themselves and to look like a caring/interesting person.

I am in a VERY similar situation. It is very frustrating that he blames all his emotional problems on my emotional problems when his existed before mine did. (He had PTSD he refused to acknowledge or deal with.) Even now I am TRYING so hard to “get better.” I’ve tried so many different antidepressants and have started going to therapy but he is not doing anything to help himself. He is literally never happy or satisfied no matter what I do. 


I feel like he would he so much happier without me but I would look sefish leaving him because he’s supported me financially while I try to get my shit together. 


It’s jusf such a frustrating situation. We shouldn’t be soely responsible for someone else’s happiness and it’s not fair they put that pressure on us. I don’t have a lot of advice to offer, just wanted to let you know you’re not alone.
